title: GovernanceFile
description: Governance mapping for a single capability — documents the regulatory rules, approval chains, disclosure obligations, and constraints that apply to that capability within a UK commercial bank.

id.description: Unique governance file identifier, e.g. GOV-001.

capability_id.description: Reference to the capability this governance file covers, e.g. CAP-001.

rules.description: Ordered list of governance rules that apply to this capability.

rule_id.description: Unique rule identifier within this governance file, e.g. GOV-001-R01.

name.description: Short descriptive name for the rule.

source_legislation.description: Primary legislation, regulation, or regulatory instrument that creates this rule.

description.description: Plain-English description of what this rule requires the bank to do or refrain from doing.

authority_level.description: Minimum organisational authority required to approve or own this rule's obligations.

approval_chain.description: Ordered list of roles / bodies that must approve decisions governed by this rule (first = initiator, last = final approval).

disclosure_obligations.description: Disclosures that must be made to regulators, customers, or the public under this rule.

constraints.description: Operational or commercial limits imposed by this rule (e.g. caps, timelines, prohibitions).

status.description: Whether this rule is already in force (current) or is upcoming regulation (incoming).

expected_date.description: For incoming rules only — the expected date or date range when the rule comes into force (ISO 8601 date or free-text range such as '2026-Q3').
